Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500 notches record-high close as rate-hike worries ease
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 closed at a record high driven by surging technology stocks and easing fears of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Memory chip makers SanDisk and Micron Technology saw significant stock price increases alongside major firms like Broadcom and Meta Platforms.

Markets.title: Average pay of CEOs of S&P 500 companies rose to record $22.8 million following Elon Musk's nearly $1 trillion compensation, AFL-CIO finds
Markets.summary: Driven by Elon Musk's massive payout, the average compensation for S&P 500 CEOs reached a record $22.8 million. This increase occurred while ordinary workers faced wage pressures and shareholder backing for special executive awards began to decline.

Markets.title: Fed’s Barkin says rate hike an ‘open question’; Hammack backs increase on inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin considers further interest rate hikes an open question. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack advocates for an immediate rate increase due to concerns that business borrowing pressures are fueling inflation.

Markets.title: FPIs emerge as biggest sellers among anchor investors in IPOs' 30-day window: Sebi study
Markets.summary: A Sebi study shows that foreign portfolio investors were the largest anchor investor sellers in initial public offerings during the 30-day post-listing window. This heavy selling pressure was particularly severe in smaller IPOs and persisted well beyond the mandatory lock-in periods.

Markets.title: Bill Ackman adds Netflix, Visa & Mastercard in biggest portfolio shake-up in years
Markets.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman significantly restructured his portfolio by adding stakes in Netflix, Visa, and Mastercard. His funds also acquired shares in Alcon, Intercontinental Exchange, S&P Global, and Microsoft.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: On the monthly expiry day, the Sensex rose 114 points while the Nifty fell over 40 points amid divergent benchmark movements. Softer inflation supported market sentiment, but elevated crude prices and geopolitical risks kept investors cautious.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: The mayor of Qusra stated that Israeli troops are ordering Palestinian families to leave their homes in the village. Soldiers are also using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks amidst settler sieges.

Geo-Political.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
Geo-Political.summary: Romania shut down its only nuclear power plant because low water levels in the Danube River caused by extreme heat hindered cooling operations. The Cernavodă facility, which generates 20% of the country's electricity, is expected to remain closed for at least 10 days.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy the country, not conquer it, as the war enters its fifth year.

Geo-Political.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
Geo-Political.summary: A US investigators' report states that an engine fan blade broke on a Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany last month. The resulting engine parts smashed a window, causing a man's head to be sucked out of the opening.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: Sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln endured deployments exceeding 250 days, leading to severe food shortages and broken plumbing. These poor conditions caused extreme distress among the crew, with some reportedly contemplating jumping overboard.

Geo-Political.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
Geo-Political.summary: A person was fined under local regulations for needlessly disturbing a sleeping polar bear with a foghorn. The regional law strictly prohibits disturbing, attracting, or pursuing polar bears.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for ads. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year, supported by a strong economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also emphasizes that India's primary challenge is ensuring workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is expected to have stayed flat at 4.4%. This projected stability occurred because a favorable base offset higher food prices while core inflation remained subdued.

India.title: 7 Killed, 2 Trapped As Water, Debris Enter Tunnel In Uttarakhand's Chamoli
India.summary: Water and debris surged into an under-construction hydropower tunnel in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district. The incident resulted in seven deaths, with two people remaining trapped inside.

India.title: Akali Dal To Continue "Punjab Bachao" Rallies Despite Attack On Sukhbir Badal
India.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal will proceed with its scheduled "Punjab Bachao" rallies despite the recent attack on party president Sukhbir Singh Badal. However, it remains uncertain whether Sukhbir Singh Badal will participate in or lead these events.

India.title: 18 Monuments Delisted From Protected Sites List Since 2021: Centre
India.summary: Since 2021, the central government has removed 18 sites from the list of protected monuments. These delisted locations include Delhi's Bara Khamba Cemetery and an ancient banyan grove containing historical building traces.

India.title: IIT Kharagpur 2nd-Year Student Dies After Falling From Hostel Building
India.summary: A second-year engineering student at IIT Kharagpur died on Thursday after falling from the fourth floor of a campus hostel building. Authorities are investigating the unusual incident in West Midnapore district.

India.title: 1991 Jammu Blast Accused Arrested After 35 Years, Was Hiding As Businessman
India.summary: Altaf Hussain Sheikh, an accused in the 1991 Jammu blast, has been arrested after evading authorities for 35 years. He was captured in South Kashmir, where he had been living under a false identity as a businessman.

India.title: 'Judiciary Does Not Take Sides, Constitution Supreme': Chief Justice
India.summary: The Chief Justice of India stated in an interview that the judiciary remains neutral and views the Constitution as the nation's supreme power. He emphasized that the judiciary's primary role is to protect and strengthen the Constitution's basic structure.

General.title: Multiple fires destroy homes and cause devastation in West Midlands
General.summary: Multiple fires destroyed homes and caused widespread devastation across the West Midlands. The regional fire service responded to thousands of emergency calls during what the fire chief called one of the most significant incidents in its history.

General.title: Watch: Aerial footage shows homes engulfed in flames in Stourbridge
General.summary: Aerial footage in Stourbridge captured multiple homes engulfed in flames. The fires burned across the West Midlands, destroying multiple residences.

General.title: Two seriously hurt as passenger train derails in East Sussex
General.summary: A passenger train derailed in East Sussex, leaving two people seriously injured. Passengers described feeling the carriage rock during the chaotic incident.

General.title: UK sees hottest day of the year as 38.1C recorded in Kew Gardens
General.summary: The UK recorded its hottest day of the year with temperatures reaching 38.1C at Kew Gardens. An amber extreme heat warning remains in place for parts of England until midnight.

General.title: Five key takeaways from results day 2026
General.summary: Top grades and university admissions increased in the 2026 results. Enrollment in technical subjects also grew more popular.

General.title: Son of 102-year-old says father died after being 'pushed off stage'
General.summary: Phillip Ormerod, aged 102, died in the hospital after his son stated he was pushed off a stage. Police have confirmed the incident and his subsequent death.
